objective.summary: Turn the current project audit into a durable, indexed refactor contract, implement the smallest proven improvements, verify each boundary, and stop the single heartbeat after a final review.
constraints: Work only in C:\\Git\\2D\\Dev; keep C:\\Git\\2D\\Original unchanged.
Do not duplicate or reopen PL-0028 Partial boundaries without new evidence.
Preserve XAML, binding, public API, Recipe/XML, Preview/Run, image/native lifetime, and shutdown contracts.
Prefer existing concrete owners; do not add one-implementation interfaces, wrappers, managers, registries, or speculative partials.
Defer optional user questions and record external rights, hardware, and deployment prerequisites without pretending they are verified.
When all criteria and the final initial-request review are complete, pause the existing heartbeat and create no replacement schedule.

criteria.text: The integrated audit/refactor contract exists under docs/reports and is reachable from the documentation routing index.
The first independent refactor slice repairs RecipeDialogAdapter visible Korean strings while preserving delegate signatures, dialog result semantics, and existing owner resolution.
Focused source checks and the smallest relevant build or contract run prove the changed boundary; unrun runtime/UI rows are explicitly recorded.
The final report rechecks the original request, names completed and unverified areas, and the heartbeat is paused with no replacement schedule.

evidence.observation: The integrated audit/refactor contract was added under docs/reports, a dedicated documentation-index route and reference were added, TestDocumentationIndex passed with IndexedPaths=298, Routes=17, RootRedirects=102, and PL-0029 validated as v2.

The visible Korean Recipe, Pipeline, file-dialog, validation-set, and delete-confirmation strings were repaired. The existing ConfirmDeleteRecipe, ConfirmDeletePipeline, ConfirmDeleteValidationSet delegate signatures and owner provider remain unchanged. The focused source contract reported RECIPE_DIALOG_LOCALIZATION_CONTRACT=PASS|checks=5 and the known mojibake search returned no matches.
The RecipeDialogLocalizationContract passed 5/5 after a successful VisionRecipeRunnerSmoke Debug build with 0 warnings and 0 errors.
Targeted git diff --check returned no whitespace errors; DocumentationIndex and PL-0029 validation both passed after the R1 change.

R2 AppPathService를 현재 소스, OPENVISIONLAB_RUNTIME_DATA_ROOT_V1_CONTRACT.md, BuildCleanRuntime.ps1과 대조했다. DEBUG 기본값은 빌드 출력 루트이고 동일 루트에서는 Release migration을 실행하지 않으며, 별도 stale-state fresh-F5 재현 전에는 새 경로 abstraction을 추가하지 않기로 기록했다.

AppPathBoundaryContract passed 8/8. Valid runtime and installation paths stayed within their roots; traversal, rooted external runtime path, capture title, and test config escape attempts were rejected.

The ImageCompareWindow retained-boundary review passed static source assertions, ImageCompare directory/resource contracts, standalone Debug build, and wpf_image_compare UI smoke. No independent extraction seam was proven and the runtime/UI limits were recorded.

The final phase summary rechecks all original request dimensions: documentation inventory and cleanup candidates, solution/Visual Studio start route and representative execution, mixed MVVM/WPF-native ownership, DLL dependency and redistribution boundary, and completed/unverified scope. It records passed final audits and states that no replacement schedule is created after the heartbeat stops.
automation_update mode=delete returned 'Deleted automation in the app' with automationId=openvisionlab-2d, deleteStatus=deleted, and no replacement automation was created.

events.summary: 최초 요청을 문서·소스·실행 증거와 다시 대조했다. 문서 inventory/routing/정리 후보, Visual Studio/solution route와 대표 WPF smoke, 혼합 MVVM owner 경계, DLL dependency/licensing 보류, 미검증 runtime/legal 범위를 통합 보고서에 확정하고, 최종 후 openvisionlab-2d heartbeat를 중지한다.
통합 문서와 최초 요청 재대조 기준을 충족했다. 예약 중지는 별도 external schedule mutation으로 수행하며, 새 예약은 만들지 않는다.
최종 원장 기록 후 `openvisionlab-2d` heartbeat를 삭제했다. 삭제 응답은 deleteStatus=deleted였고 대체 automation은 만들지 않았다.
